# mbse-sysarch

> System architectures as mbse-schemas data. Interactions: modules kept by name in the store's library, each with interfaces and ports (each port "in" or "out"); implementations of a module by instances of other modules, cooperating asynchronously over channels, each channel carrying messages of one schema (linked as the schema object) from its sources to its destinations, delivered BROADCAST, ANYCAST or ROUND_ROBIN. Structure: containers holding their contents hard (structure) or soft (organization, where another container organizes them), and axes that soft containers lie along. Checks list what no unique clause can express. Python (`mbse.Architecture.Systems`) on mbse-schemas 0.22.0; TypeScript is planned.

## Why

- [MBSE.md](https://github.com/pitaman71/mbse-basis/blob/main/MBSE.md): executable specifications, and each mbse repository's part in them
